notes: At 100k users the k6 test runner itself needs horizontal distribution.
Use the k6 operator with parallelism >= 20 pods, each pod handles ~5k VUs.
Redis must be in cluster mode (min 3 shards) - standalone will OOM.
PgBouncer default_pool_size should be tuned to match PostgreSQL max_connections.
ScyllaDB must have 3+ nodes; increase RF=3 for the messaging keyspace.
Consider splitting k8s namespaces: echo-stress-infra vs echo-stress-app.
RabbitMQ shovel or federation may be needed if queue depth exceeds memory.
